name: audiobook-tracker
description: 有声书追踪器 - 基于 Supabase 的完整全栈应用

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c amber,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
